headline: Dec 2026 is predicted to have the highest activity, at 1,989 applications.
detail: That is 10.7% of the forecast year's total, with a 95% prediction interval of 1,051 to 2,488.

headline: 3 high-activity month(s) predicted: May 2026, Jun 2026 and Dec 2026.
detail: These months carry 30% of forecast annual volume. Matching capacity, partner supply and reviewer bandwidth should be staged ahead of them.

headline: Total 2026 applications are forecast at 18,655, 2.3% above 2025.
detail: 2025 closed at 18,229. The forecast averages 1,555 applications per month.

headline: Lowest predicted activity falls in Feb 2026, Mar 2026.
detail: These are the natural windows for member training, partner development and process work, since delivery pressure is at its lowest.

headline: Application volume increased by 6.1% in 2025 compared with 2024.
detail: 2025 recorded 18,229 applications against 17,183 the year before, an average of 1,519 per month.

headline: Exchange activity grew at a compound annual rate of 22.8% between 2022 and 2025.
detail: Total applications rose 85% over 3 years, from 9,854 to 18,229.

headline: Peak season runs from Nov to Jan.
detail: 3 consecutive months sit at or above the annual average. Dec is the single strongest month at 1.33x the average.

headline: Feb is the quietest month, running at 0.75x the annual average.
detail: Dec carries 1.8x the volume of Feb. Recruitment and matching capacity should be planned around this swing rather than a flat monthly assumption.

headline: The biggest drop-off is APP to ACH, losing 56% of candidates.
detail: 33,579 of 60,302 applied candidates do not reach achieved / matched. This transition is the highest-leverage place to intervene.

headline: 19.4% of applications convert all the way to a realization.
detail: 11,710 realizations from 60,302 applications. Roughly 5 applications are needed per realization, which is the ratio to plan recruitment targets against.

headline: The top 5 Local Committees generate 49% of all applications.
detail: AIESEC in Delhi IIT leads with 10,611 applications (17.6% of the MC) across 20 entities.

headline: AIESEC in Bangalore is the fastest-growing large LC at +100.4% (2022->2025).
detail: It now contributes 5.1% of MC applications with an application-to-realization rate of 18.6%.

headline: oGV is the largest programme at 51% of all applications.
detail: oGV peaks in Dec. oGTa converts best, with 27.8% of applications reaching realization versus 18.1% for oGV.

headline: The selected model (ridge) achieves 93.6% accuracy in walk-forward validation (MAPE 6.4%).
detail: Mean absolute error is 92 applications per month across 24 out-of-sample origins. That is strong for operational planning; treat the prediction interval, not the point estimate, as the planning range.
